top_choice_rationale: P001 awards the optical lattice clock to Katori and Ye. It is a bounded invention with a clear before and after, since magic-wavelength confinement removes light-shift, Doppler and recoil limits for many neutral atoms at once. The 10^-18 performance has been reproduced in several independent laboratories, and the two-name credit has no evident missing principal. The dependence on the comb and ion-clock prizes is real but can be handled by a citation that names the magic-wavelength lattice. This is a valid discovery or invention with identifiable originators, so I rank it above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001; I have no documented tie to Katori or Ye and precision atomic metrology is outside my TEM field. My earlier preference for spherical-aberration correction (B053) was in my own field and is not on this slate.
